authority.owner_message: bump Python, SDKs and everything else to latest too
authority.landing_condition: three-model Debate Round before the change lands

play_compliance.statement: Google Play requires target API 36 for phone from 2026-08-31 (API 35 for Wear OS, API 34 for Android TV); target API 37 exceeds that requirement for phone, Android TV, and Wear OS.

upstream_evidence.agp: 9.4.1 (Google Maven maven-metadata; AGP 9.4 maximum supported API level is 37, minimum Gradle 9.6.0, JDK 17, Build-Tools 36.0.0)
upstream_evidence.ndk: r30 30.0.16248370, Latest LTS on https://developer.android.com/ndk/downloads, GitHub android/ndk release r30 published 2026-09-08, not a prerelease
upstream_evidence.play_services_wearable: 20.0.1 is recommended by Google as the minimum for apps targeting API 37

api_37_adoption_requirements.requirement: Install and freeze reviewed Android SDK Build-Tools 37.x. Build-Tools 36.0.0 remains the hash-pinned release toolchain until the owner stages 37.0.0 and its apksigner.jar SHA-256 is recorded.
Complete API 37 Android TV runtime qualification.
Complete API 37 Wear OS runtime qualification.
Decide whether private or LAN VPN gateways are supported and implement the Android 17 local-network permission contract or reject physical-LAN endpoints.
Validate the Android TV UI when orientation, aspect-ratio, or resizability restrictions are ignored.
Validate certificate transparency and ECH or ECH GREASE behavior, including blocked or stripped ECH and redirect-safe pinning.
Run full native ABI load and tunnel-start tests for every shipped Flutter, Winn v3, AmneziaWG, and Xray binary, rebuilt against NDK r30.

decision: Move phone, Android TV, and Wear OS to compileSdk 37, targetSdk 37, and the latest final stable NDK r30 (30.0.16248370) under the owner direction of 2026-10-06 to bump every pinned third-party component to latest stable. The API 37 adoption requirements carried over from the 2026-09-13 exception stay open qualification items for the release candidate, not preconditions of this pin change. Release 1.0.16+33 artifacts already built on API 36 and NDK r29 are not re-labelled by this ruling.
